stories.title: Gabon lifts eight‑month social‑media ban
stories.summary: Gabon’s High Communication Authority announced on Saturday that the nationwide ban on social‑media platforms, imposed on 17 February, has been lifted. The ban had been justified by authorities as a response to online content they said was fueling conflict and deepening divisions. During the restriction many users resorted to VPNs to access the sites.
stories.why: Restoring social‑media access restores a key channel for information, communication and civic engagement.
